prevention.resources: one audit week and report-owner interviews
prevention.verification: audit list signed by report owners

response.resources: licence renewal quote and descoped report list
response.earliest_time: as soon as the audit shows the gap

paths.new_costs_and_risks: Preparation time is spent even if the event succeeds.
paths.assumption: The legacy report definitions are complete and current.
paths.event: A third of the legacy reports turn out to use undocumented manual steps.
paths.mechanism: Migration stalls report by report while the team reverse-engineers steps nobody recorded.
paths.early_signal: The first migrated report needs two undocumented manual corrections.
paths.consequence: Schedule slips past the licence end and the team must renew the old tool at full price.
paths.stop_condition: If the audit finds more than ten undocumented reports, stop and re-plan the scope.

plan.plan: Deliver the internal reporting tool migration in six weeks with the current team.
plan.success: All reports run on the new tool and the old tool is decommissioned.
plan.failure: The migration slips past the quarter end or a critical report breaks.
plan.hard_constraints: No additional hires; the old tool licence ends at quarter end.
